Okay, I've just started my second session. Alison has confirmed that she has booked the meeting for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. I need to provide the day, start time, and body of the email.

*   Day: "Thu"
*   Start: "14:30"
*   Body: I'll write a professional and concise email confirming the meeting details.

After sending the email, the task will be complete, and I can end my session.Excellent. I will send the confirmation email now.
